design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (autoship_subscription_care), frozen_time 2026-10-06 15:05:00 EDT.
STEP 0 DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"task": 1, "key": "env_0040_pet_supplies_retailer/autoship_subscription_care/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4]}. Tree = root + 1 prerequisite problem; factor counts: new pet's frequency 6, existing Autoship re-size 4 (multiset 6,4 = draw).
SCOPE SNAPSHOT: task 0 occupies the pharmacy package-count and re-timing rules, the shared-household re-time after a pet leaves for a prescription diet, and the prescription-diet enrollment (tools set_rx_shipment_packages_d23afb64, set_rx_shipment_interval_b175142c, set_shipment_interval_36e38cde, enroll_rx_autoship_732fccd3). This task claims the two remaining policies, autoship_ext_existing_pet_quantity and autoship_ext_second_pet_enrollment_interval, with the two remaining tools set_shipment_quantity_8a323a9d and enroll_everyday_autoship_7ae73b8d; after it every extended policy is covered exactly once and no policy or tool is left idle.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the customer asks for one thing - a separate Autoship for his second dog on the same kibble, first bags with the other dog's next delivery. The frequency he will confirm comes from the household's usage less what Bruno's Autoship covers, and Bruno's Autoship is still doubled (4 bags every 8 weeks) since Maple arrived; the new pet's rule's prerequisite sentence makes the agent re-size Bruno's Autoship to Bruno's own usage first, and that re-size has its own 4-factor rule. Read six categories of records (Autoship ledger, membership, wellness plans, training, prescription, pets) and get two integers exactly right in order.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root autoship_ext_second_pet_enrollment_interval (target enroll_everyday_autoship_7ae73b8d, owner=user) <- autoship_ext_existing_pet_quantity (value_input, gate existing_weekly_units, action form, resolved by set_shipment_quantity_8a323a9d, owner=agent).
  Prerequisite sentence (blocked side, verbatim, affirmative direction): "The weeks between shipments of a second pet's own Autoship for an item the household already receives are worked out only after the existing Autoship of that item has been re-sized to its own pet's usage." Four-point test: ordering connective "only after"; waits on a plainly named action (re-sizing the existing Autoship to its own pet's usage) because the state it leaves - a units-per-shipment number - could equally be left by an ordinary quantity change (fallback_reason on the edge); no tool, id or code token; hard requirement. Derivation: sentence + records (Bruno's Autoship quantity 4 rose from 2 in April; customer says both dogs eat from it) + the re-size rule's scope sentence -> the one action is the re-size of cd02e174-d788-43a3-bd62-fb56c73e34d6.
  Seed evidence false at the opening: cd02e174-d788-43a3-bd62-fb56c73e34d6.quantity = 4 (rule gives 2). Topological order: re-size, then enrollment. Deletion sensitivity: without the re-size the existing Autoship covers 0.5 units/week, the whole household usage, and the new pet's frequency is undefined (division by zero) instead of 8.
  user_scenario never asks to change Bruno's Autoship; the tools validate nothing.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: re-size (autoship_modify) inherits changeable_status (status active) and before_change_cutoff (next ship 2026-11-23, Autoship Everyday cutoff 1 calendar day counted backward, inclusive; last in-time day 2026-11-22; 2026-10-06 in time). Enrollment (autoship_enroll) inherits one_live_subscription_per_item_and_pet (the only live subscription of sku TW-310482 is for Bruno, not Maple, so no duplicate), pet_profile_linked (Maple belongs to the customer), fresh_zone (Autoship Everyday does not require the refrigerated zone; the profile flag false does not matter), rx_active_for_pharmacy (Autoship Everyday does not require a prescription; no prescription is linked, Bruno's preventive is a different item). overwrite [] on both policies.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: object cd02e174-d788-43a3-bd62-fb56c73e34d6 (Bruno's Autoship Everyday, sku TW-310482). Rows read: scheduled charges 2025-10-20, 2025-12-15, 2026-02-09 at 2 bags (Bruno alone, between six and twelve months ago); 2026-04-13, 2026-06-08, 2026-08-03 at 4 bags (both dogs, last six months); ship-now 2026-06-29 (1 bag); replacement 2026-06-10 for one damaged bag of the 2026-06-08 shipment; customer skip 2026-09-28. Nothing settled or reversed; Tailwise Plus active so no shipping fees.
FACTOR CARD:
 re-size (autoship_ext_existing_pet_quantity), result 2, all-baseline 4:
  - [method] pre_rise_usage_basis: tier taken = "the household's usage rose in the last six months and pre_rise_min_charges or more scheduled shipments were charged between six and twelve months ago" -> the existing pet's usage is the units of those shipments divided by half_year_weeks weeks; evidence units_6m=12.0, charges_12m=6, charges_6m=3, household_rose=True, own_pet_weekly_units=0.23076923076923078; decides own_pet_weekly_units=0.23076923076923078; under its baseline (units_12m / K('year_weeks')) the result would be 3 instead of 2.
  - [parameter] member_cushion: tier taken = "membership in status active is a Tailwise Plus tier and member_min_charges or more scheduled shipments of the subscription were charged in the last twelve months" -> K('plus_cushion_days'); evidence mem_tier='Tailwise Plus Annual', scheduled_charges_12m=6, cushion_days=7; decides cushion_days=7; under its baseline (K('standard_cushion_days')) the result would be 3 instead of 2.
  - [parameter] skip_trim: tier taken = "exactly one customer-requested skip on the subscription in the last six months" -> K('skip_single_trim_days'); evidence customer_skips_6m=1, skip_trim_days=2; decides skip_trim_days=2; under its baseline (0) the result would be 3 instead of 2.
  - [parameter] life_stage_trim: tier taken = "the existing pet holds a Senior Dog Wellness Plan or Senior Cat Wellness Plan in status active" -> K('senior_trim_days'); evidence own_pet_plan='Senior Dog Wellness Plan', life_stage_trim_days=2; decides life_stage_trim_days=2; under its baseline (0) the result would be 3 instead of 2.
  - units_12m = 18.0  (SUM('autoship_events','quantity', within_months=12, event_type='autoship_shipment_charge', shipment_kind='scheduled'))
  - own_pet_unit_days = 30.333333333333332  (K('week_days') / own_pet_weekly_units)
  - own_interval_days = 56  (F('frequency_weeks') * K('week_days'))
  - days_to_cover = 59  (own_interval_days + cushion_days - skip_trim_days - life_stage_trim_days)
  - result = 2  (int(MN(P('max_quantity_per_shipment'), MX(1, -(-days_to_cover // own_pet_unit_days)))))
 new pet's frequency (autoship_ext_second_pet_enrollment_interval), result 8, all-baseline 9:
  - [method] settled_household_window: tier taken = "the household's usage rose in the last six months and settled_min_charges or more scheduled shipments were charged in the last six months" -> usage is the units of all shipments charged in the last six months, ship-now included, divided by half_year_weeks weeks; evidence all_units_6m=13.0, all_units_3m=4.0, household_rose=True, household_weekly_units=0.5; decides household_weekly_units=0.5; under its baseline (units_6m / K('half_year_weeks')) the result would be 10 instead of 8.
  - [parameter] skip_stretch: tier taken = "exactly one customer-requested skip on the existing Autoship in the last six months" -> K('skip_single_days'); evidence customer_skips_6m=1, skip_stretch_days=7; decides skip_stretch_days=7; under its baseline (0) the result would be 7 instead of 8.
  - [parameter] training_treat_stretch: tier taken = "a training enrollment in status in_progress and course_min_sessions or more of that enrollment's own sessions attended in the last course_window_months months" -> K('course_active_days'); evidence course_status='in_progress', course_sessions_recent=4, course_stretch_days=9; decides course_stretch_days=9; under its baseline (0) the result would be 7 instead of 8.
  - [parameter] growing_pet_pull: tier taken = "no puppy or kitten plan, and an Adult Dog Wellness Plan or Adult Cat Wellness Plan in status active enrolled no more than young_adult_days days ago" -> K('young_adult_pull_days'); evidence young_plan=False, adult_plan_age_days=192, growth_pull_days=2; decides growth_pull_days=2; under its baseline (0) the result would be 9 instead of 8.
  - [parameter] replacement_delivery_lead: tier taken = "exactly one replacement shipment released on the existing Autoship in the last twelve months" -> K('replacement_single_lead_days'); evidence replacements_12m=1, delivery_lead_days=5; decides delivery_lead_days=5; under its baseline (P('delivery_days_after_ship')) the result would be 9 instead of 8.
  - [parameter] ship_now_pull: tier taken = "exactly one ship-now shipment charged on the existing Autoship in the last six months" -> K('shipnow_single_days'); evidence ship_now_6m=1, ship_now_pull_days=3; decides ship_now_pull_days=3; under its baseline (0) the result would be 9 instead of 8.
  - units_12m = 18.0  (SUM('autoship_events','quantity', within_months=12, event_type='autoship_shipment_charge', shipment_kind='scheduled'))
  - units_6m = 12.0  (SUM('autoship_events','quantity', within_months=6, event_type='autoship_shipment_charge', shipment_kind='scheduled'))
  - charges_12m = 6  (COUNT('autoship_events', within_months=12, event_type='autoship_shipment_charge', shipment_kind='scheduled'))
  - charges_6m = 3  (COUNT('autoship_events', within_months=6, event_type='autoship_shipment_charge', shipment_kind='scheduled'))
  - existing_weekly_units = 0.25  (F('quantity') / F('frequency_weeks'))
  - new_pet_weekly_units = 0.25  (household_weekly_units - existing_weekly_units)
  - new_pet_unit_days = 28.0  (K('week_days') / new_pet_weekly_units)
  - interval_days = 62.0  (F('quantity') * new_pet_unit_days + skip_stretch_days + course_stretch_days - growth_pull_days - delivery_lead_days - ship_now_pull_days)
  - result = 8  (int(MN(P('max_frequency_weeks'), MX(P('min_frequency_weeks'), int(interval_days / K('week_days'))))))
 Multi-source: member_cushion (Plus tier AND scheduled charges) and training_treat_stretch (enrollment in progress AND that enrollment's sessions in the last month). Cross-difficulty: member, vet, train. Methods: pre_rise_usage_basis (pre-rise six-month window / per-shipment interval rate / twelve-month average) and settled_household_window (all charged units over six months / all units over three months / scheduled units over six months). Near-misses: the ship-now counts only under the settled-household window; Bruno's Senior plan bears on the re-size, not on Maple's growing-pet tier (which reads Maple's Adult Dog plan enrolled 192 days ago); the replacement shipment is not a charge and adds no units.
PERSONA: Marcus is brisk and friendly, volunteers the goal, the timing (with Bruno's next delivery, pantry full) and his mobile number; email only when asked; that both dogs eat from Bruno's Autoship only when asked; agrees to change Bruno's Autoship only after an explanation; runs the enrollment himself; never offers a quantity or frequency.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate+verify -> read pets, Autoship, ledger, prescription, vet, membership, wellness plans, store, training enrollment and sessions -> re-size Bruno's Autoship to 2 -> hand over Maple's enrollment (2 bags every 8 weeks from 2026-11-23, same sku/description/price/weight, no prescription).
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: re-size: usage rose (4 vs 2 per shipment) with 3 scheduled shipments between six and twelve months ago (>= 3) -> Bruno alone 6 bags / 26 weeks = 0.2308 per week -> 30.33 days per bag; covered days 8x7 = 56 + cushion (Plus, 6 charges: plus_cushion_days 7) - 2 skip - 2 senior = 59 -> 59/30.33 = 1.95 -> 2 bags (the twelve-month standard 18/52 would give 20.2 days per bag and 3 bags). New pet: usage rose with 3 charges in six months -> all units 13/26 = 0.5 per week; Bruno's Autoship covers 2/8 = 0.25 -> Maple 0.25 per week -> 28 days per bag -> 2 bags = 56 + 7 skip + 9 training (4 of that enrollment's own sessions in the last month) - 2 young adult - 5 replacement room - 3 ship-now = 62 -> 8 weeks. Agrees with gold.
REVISIONS: (1) existing Autoship moved to an 8-week interval with doubled 4-bag shipments so per-dog consumption is realistic (about 1 lb a day each); (2) life-stage and tenure ladders given distinct outcomes for every tier (young pets and new subscriptions add days); (3) the new pet ships the existing Autoship's units per shipment rather than a fixed constant, so both edges of the value chain are record-driven.
ROUND 2 REVISIONS (policy-task audit, first revision): T1-1/F-G3d - member_cushion relabelled parameter with plain tier values (plus_cushion_days 7 / rewards_cushion_days 11 / standard_cushion_days 14); a genuine method factor pre_rise_usage_basis now decides the existing pet's usage (pre-rise six-month window / per-shipment interval rate when fewer than three pre-rise shipments / twelve-month household average as the standard); tenure_trim (O-G5, weakly grounded) removed so the count stays at the drawn 4; skip_trim and the senior trim re-set to 2 days so each still bears weight (covered days 59 against 60.67 for two bags). F-G2 - training sessions are now counted only for the in_progress enrollment (train_enrollment_id filter), matching 'that enrollment's own sessions'. F-G4 - every rule now states the month-window convention; no record of this world sits on a window boundary. O-G2 - 'did not rise when either period has no scheduled shipment' stated. T1-O3 - the enrollment's rx_prescription_id is passed as null, the value Bruno's Autoship shows and the tool stores. T1-O4 - find_rx_prescriptions supplies the evidence of the inherited prescription check on every enrollment; find_veterinarians and find_stores read foreign-key parents the seed must carry; none feeds a factor. T1-O2 - the rule's 'the same units per shipment as the existing Autoship carries' is read at the root's handling time, after the re-size, as the closure records. Propagated to rule, compute, compute_basis, factors, computations, tracing and this dossier.
ROUND 3 NOTE (policy-task audit, revision 2): task 1 passed; no change to its scope. R2-O4 accepted as an observation: the existing-pet fall-through (twelve-month usage of the whole subscription) is the stated naive standard that pre_rise_usage_basis corrects, and it is the figure an agent who never finds that factor would use (3 bags, against gold 2). The charter-wide month-window convention and the household fixed-point fix do not touch this world (re-size re-evaluated after its write gives 2 again).
user_scenario: You are Marcus Delgado, a high-school chemistry teacher in Somerville, calling on a Tuesday afternoon between classes, a little rushed but friendly. You have two dogs: Bruno, a seven-year-old Labrador who has been on Tailwise Autoship for years, and Maple, a lab mix you adopted this past March who is now about a year and a half old and in a Saturday basic manners class. You want to set Maple up with her own Autoship for the same food Bruno gets - the large-breed chicken and brown rice kibble - so each dog has a subscription in their own name, and you'd like to have Maple's first bags come with Bruno's next delivery rather than right away, since the pantry is full. You open with your name and your mobile number, 6175550143. If the agent needs a second detail to confirm it's you, you give your email address, marcus.delgado@gmail.com; you don't have your card or the date you opened the account handy and say so if those are asked for. If the agent asks who eats the food on Bruno's subscription, you explain that both dogs eat out of what comes on Bruno's Autoship and that you bumped it up when Maple came home in March. You don't know how much food each dog should get or how often it should ship and you never offer a number - you trust Tailwise to work it out from your history. If the agent tells you that something about Bruno's existing Autoship has to be changed before Maple's can be set up, you ask what it will mean for Bruno's deliveries, and once they've explained you say that's fine and to go ahead with it. When the agent says Maple's Autoship is ready for you to start and hands it to you, you run it yourself with exactly the details the agent reads out to you and then confirm the reference number you see. As soon as Maple's Autoship shows as set up you say thanks and hang up.
